title: fix(plugins,react,i18n): bound registrations stop requiring `objectName`, and a node with neither shows a no-object hint (objectui#11605)
body:
Fixes #11605
Clause-②: yes

## What changes

Every object-bound registration whose spec row, or the documented binding contract, waives `objectName` stops declaring it `required: true`, and each one gains a `description` that names the binding. So the page compile (`compile()` in `@object-ui/sdui-parser`, whose `ok` is the save gate) accepts a node whose `dataSource.object` names the object. This is the triage ruling (a), the same move as objectui#11569 (PR objectui#11604).

Each member that answered a node with neither key with a blank now shows a visible hint instead: "No object named: set objectName or dataSource.object." The hint comes from one place. `ElementDataSourceGate` gains an opt-in `requiresObject` prop, and each call site states whether its block has another record source. The hint is drawn after the binding lands, so a bound node never sees it. The string is the new `view.noObject` key in all ten packs, worded as `element.number.noObject` with the property as a hole.

No new manifest vocabulary and no new compile rule (ruling (a), "no (b)"). `packages/types` and `sdui-parser` are not edited.

## The census, and one evidence line per site

The census was re-run at the base `b92329c` three ways:
- `git grep "name: 'objectName'.*required: true"` finds 16 sites.
- A looser pass finds the multi-line form (`name: 'objectName',` alone on a line) on 3 inputs (`action:button`, `action:icon`, `object-tree`), none required. A double-quoted spelling finds 0.
- The manifest-derived census is the one the gate reads. Read off the shipped `sdui.manifest.json`, `objectName` was required on 10 public tags: the 9 members below plus `record:related_list`. The other 6 sites are non-public aliases or blocks.

Per site, the reading is: does the registered renderer wrap `ElementDataSourceGate` (so `dataSource.object` lands on `objectName`, the default mapping key), and what do the spec row and the binding doc say.

| Site (cited by symbol) | Tags | Gate-wrapped | Spec row / doc | Decision | Neither node, before, then after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `plugin-grid` `GRID_QUERY_INPUTS` | `object-grid`, `view:grid` | yes (`ObjectGridRenderer`) | row: optional "because the component-level `dataSource` binding can supply the object instead" | drop | its own red "Object name required for data fetching" error, which is a hint already; not opted in |
| `plugin-kanban` `OBJECT_KANBAN_INPUTS` | `object-kanban` | yes (`ObjectKanbanRenderer`) | row: optional, same reason | drop | "No cards" empty board, now the hint |
| `plugin-dashboard` `object-metric` registration | `object-metric` | yes (`ObjectMetricBlock`) | row: optional, same reason | drop | a bare dash, now the hint |
| `plugin-dashboard` `object-pivot` registration | `object-pivot` | yes (`ObjectPivotBlock`) | no row; doc table row `object-pivot` | drop | "loaded successfully and its query returned no records yet", now the hint |
| `plugin-dashboard` `object-data-table` registration | `object-data-table` (not public) | no: `ObjectDataTable` is registered bare | no binding supplies it | **keep** | n/a |
| `plugin-list` `list-view` registration | `list-view` | yes (`ListViewBlock`) | no row; doc table row, plus the `list-view` record-source rule that counts the binding | drop | "Nothing here yet" empty state, now the hint |
| `plugin-list` `list` registration | `view:list` (not public) | yes (same `ListViewBlock`) | as `list-view` | drop | as `list-view` |
| `plugin-charts` `ObjectChart.tsx` `object-chart` registration (outside triage's 15) | `object-chart` | yes (`ObjectChartBlock`) | no row; doc table row `object-chart` | drop | an empty chart frame with no message, now the hint |
| `plugin-charts` `index.tsx` `chart` registration | `view:chart` (not public) | yes (same `ObjectChartBlock`) | as `object-chart` | drop | as `object-chart` |
| `plugin-form` `object-form` registration | `object-form` | yes (`ObjectFormRenderer`) | row: optional, same reason | drop (shared `OBJECT_FORM_OBJECT_NAME_INPUT`) | a field-less card with Cancel / Update, now the hint |
| `plugin-form` `form` registration | `view:form` (not public) | yes (same renderer) | as `object-form` | drop (same const) | as `object-form` |
| `plugin-form` `embeddable-form` registration | `embeddable-form` | yes (`EmbeddableFormRenderer`) | no row; doc table row | drop (`formId` stays required) | a form with no fields and a Submit button, now the hint |
| `plugin-form` `object-master-detail-form` registration | `object-master-detail-form` | yes (`MasterDetailFormRenderer`) | row: optional, same reason | drop (`details` stays required) | an empty parent form and a detail note about a link to a blank parent, now the hint |
| `plugin-detail` `detail` registration | `view:detail` (not public) | no: registers the raw `DetailView` | no binding supplies it | **keep** | n/a |
| `plugin-detail` `related_list` registration | `record:related_list` | yes | row: **requires** `objectName` | **keep**, by spec row | n/a |
| `plugin-view` `object-view` registration | `object-view` (not public) | no: `ObjectViewRenderer` reads no binding | no binding supplies it | **keep** | n/a |

"Before" was measured through `SchemaRenderer` under a provider with a recording adapter, at the base. Every member made zero data calls, and none threw. After the change, each opted-in member draws the hint and still makes zero data calls (pin rows below).

Other record sources opt out of the hint, each read from the block's own fetch guard. Lists take inline `data`. Forms (`object-form`, `view:form`) take inline fields, answered by the shared `hasInlineFieldSource`: non-empty `customFields`, or `sections` whose every field is inline, the collector the `tabbed`, `wizard`, `split`, `drawer` and `modal` variants render. Kanban takes `data`, a `bind` path, a parent view's rows, or lanes that carry their own `cards`. Metric takes `fallbackValue`. Chart takes `data`, `dataset` or `bind`. Pivot takes `data` or `bind`. Embeddable and master-detail have none.

## Accept-set changes (for the contract review)

Measured against the manifest the console ships (`buildArtifacts` over `dev/manifest-registry.ts`). "Before" is the base `b92329c`; "after" is this head.

| Node | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| each of the 9 public members with `dataSource={{ object: "account" }}` and its other required props, no `objectName` | `ok: false`, one `missing-required-prop` error naming `objectName` | `ok: true`, no diagnostics, the binding site recorded |
| each of those 9 with neither `objectName` nor a binding | `ok: false`, the same error | no compile diagnostic about `objectName`; the runtime answers with the hint (or the grid's own error) |
| `embeddable-form` naming `objectName` but no `formId` (control) | refused, one error naming `formId` | the same |
| `record:related_list` without `objectName` (control) | refused naming `objectName` | the same; its spec row requires it |

Generated artifacts move with it, from the same generator: the `sdui.manifest.json` entries, `sdui-intrinsics.d.ts` (`objectName?: string` on the 9 tags) and the `sdui-blocks.md` required-props column. None of them is tracked.

The zod faces (`objectui validate`) were read and not touched. A bound node of each member passes `safeValidateSchema` at this head, and the record-source refinements still refuse some neither nodes there.

## Pins

New:
- `apps/console/src/__tests__/objectname-binding-required-11605.test.ts`, judged against the shipped `sdui.manifest.json`:
  - **The enumeration pin.** The bound population is read from the manifest itself: entries whose inputs carry the injected `dataSource` input with `binding: 'object'`. For each, every `required: true` input must be required by its `ComponentPropsMap` row, not supplied by the binding, or in the `LEDGER` with a reason. It runs one test per tag, so a new contradiction is red by name. What the binding supplies is read off the binding doc's "which keys each one honours" table: the object key (`objectName`, `childObject` on `record:line_items`, `object` on `element:*`), plus `columns` where a named view fills them.
  - The ledger holds one row, `record:related_list.columns` (see Acceptance notes). A stale row is red.
  - The doc table must name every bound tag, and each object key must be an input the entry declares.
  - Per member: `objectName` not required with a description naming `dataSource.object`; the bound node compiles `ok`; the neither node draws no `objectName` diagnostic. Plus the two controls in the table above.
- `apps/console/src/__tests__/objectname-neither-hint-11605.test.tsx`, for 11 tags (the 9 public members plus `view:list`, `view:form` and `view:chart`):
  - The neither node draws `TESTID-no-object` with the exact sentence and makes zero data calls.
  - Controls: no hint with `objectName`, none when bound by `dataSource.object`, none with the block's other record source, and none on a kanban whose lanes carry `cards`.
  - For `object-form` and `view:form`, each sectioned `formType` (`tabbed`, `wizard`, `split`, `drawer`, `modal`) with fully-inline sections renders its collector, not the hint (10 rows, red before `34eda84`).
- `packages/react/src/element-data-source/__tests__/ElementDataSourceGate.requiresObject-11605.test.tsx`: the gate's own rows.
  - The hint names the mapping's key (`childObject` under `object: 'childObject'`).
  - A blank name names nothing.
  - The binding lands before the check.
  - No opt-in, or `object: false`, changes nothing.

**Reproduced first.** The two console pins were run against the base `b92329c` in a separate worktree. 47 rows were red: 9 enumeration rows, 9 published-input rows, 9 bound-compile rows, 9 neither-compile rows and 11 hint rows. Each enumeration row named its tag, for example "object-grid declares "objectName" required, but its `dataSource` binding supplies it and its spec row does not require it". All controls were green. At `34eda84` all 108 rows pass across the three new files (hint 53, enumeration 48, gate 7).

**Ablations**, on the committed fix, through `ablation-replace.mjs`. The console project aliases each `@object-ui/plugin-*` and `@object-ui/react` to `src`, so a mutation reaches the test without a build.
1. `required: true` put back on `object-grid`'s `objectName` (`packages/plugin-grid/src/index.tsx`, blob `103b678daf64` became `b146f9f85b4d`): 4 rows went red (enumeration, published input, bound compile, neither compile), each naming `object-grid`, with 44 passed.
2. The same on `object-form`, through `OBJECT_FORM_OBJECT_NAME_INPUT` (`69df173d5b9f` became `4706c474205e`): the same 4 rows went red, naming `object-form`.
3. Kanban's gained hint removed by falsifying its `requiresObject` predicate (`54919dea475e` became `21d282a24bf0`): exactly the `object-kanban` neither-hint row went red, with 42 passed.
4. The object-form opt-out put back to the `customFields`-only predicate (`packages/plugin-form/src/index.tsx`, blob `b730e588d559` became `db8cd30dafb7`): exactly the 10 sectioned-variant rows went red, 43 passed; restored by blob hash.

Each restore is proven by blob hash: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. Ablations 1 and 3 each had a first attempt the tool refused before any test ran, because the replacement contained its own anchor. Those attempts restored to HEAD and measured nothing.

**Reverse type check.** `requiresObject={` was renamed `requiresObjekt={` in `plugin-kanban`. `tsc --noEmit` then failed with TS2322 against the rebuilt `@object-ui/react` declarations, and the file was restored by blob hash (`54919dea475e`).

## Other edits

- **Fixtures that pinned the old behaviour, each re-read rather than re-spelled:**
  - `plugin-kanban` `index.test.ts`: "objectName is required" became "declared, not required, names `dataSource.object`".
  - `plugin-form` `embeddable-form-arm-inputs-11440.test.ts`: the required list is now `['formId']`. The arm's record-source rule is unchanged.
  - `plugin-kanban` `registration.test.tsx`: the stub probe now names its object.
  - `plugin-list` `htmlTierColumnSpellings-6598.test.tsx` form 8a: `object-name` still fails loudly, now through the block's hint rather than the compile error. The invariant's "(b) fails loudly" names both.
  - Console `sdui-workbench-preview-listview-binding-8510.test.tsx`: the stripped-binding control waits on the list's hint. Its data-call assertions are unchanged.
- **Comment-only:** two `guideCrudAppRenders` test headers said the block "declares `objectName` as required".
- `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs`: an `ADJUDICATED` entry for the new pin's read of `content/docs/guide/data-source.md`. Its `--audit` is green, and `scripts/__tests__/markdown-test-inputs.test.ts` passes.
- `content/docs/guide/data-source.md`: one prose paragraph, no code fence. It says the page compile accepts a bound node on the `objectName` rows, with `record:related_list` as the exception. It also states the hint, the grid's own error, and which record sources opt out.
- `packages/react/README.md`: one prose paragraph on `requiresDataSource` and `requiresObject`, no code fence.
- **Changesets**, one per package that moves, each `minor`, each widening paragraph opening `**Clause-②: yes (widening)** —`: `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `plugin-kanban`, `plugin-dashboard`, `plugin-list`, `plugin-charts`, `plugin-form`, `react` (the new optional prop) and `i18n` (the new key). `@object-ui/console` changes only test files, the same standing objectui#11604's review accepted.

## Verification (head `34eda84`)

- **The patch round, `582982e` → `34eda84`:**
  - `067f3f0`: `chartNeedsObject` reads `data` and `bind` as `BaseSchema` members and `dataset` with `Reflect.get`, so there is no second `bind` declaration (`base-bind-declared.test.ts` green; `plugin-charts` suite 89 files, 1213 passed / 9 skipped; type-check exit 0).
  - `34eda84`: the form opt-out uses `hasInlineFieldSource` (`plugin-form` suite 163 files, 1889 passed / 1 skipped; type-check exit 0).
  - Every test that scans the tree wholesale was re-run at `34eda84`: 127 package/app files (2576 passed) and 69 scripts files (2816 passed). The gates listed below were re-run at `34eda84`, each exit 0.
  - The rest of this section was measured at `582982e`.

- **Build:** `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2` filtered to the `^...` closure of the six changed plugins. Exit 0, 14 tasks, 7 cache hits; `@object-ui/react` and `@object-ui/i18n` rebuilt.
- **`type-check`:** each of `react`, `i18n`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-kanban`, `plugin-dashboard`, `plugin-list`, `plugin-charts` and `plugin-form` exits 0 (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`). `react` was re-run at this head.
- **Full package suites** (`pnpm exec vitest run packages/PKG/`):
  - `plugin-dashboard` + `plugin-charts`: 257 files, 2882 passed, 15 skipped.
  - `plugin-form`: 163 files, 1889 passed, 1 skipped.
  - `plugin-grid`: 185 files, 1711 passed.
  - `plugin-list` + `plugin-kanban`: 178 files, 1663 passed.
  - `react` + `i18n`: 187 files, 2689 passed, 13 skipped.
  - `plugin-view` + `examples/schema-catalog`: 104 files, 2861 passed.
  - All of `apps/console`: 145 files, all pass after the 8510 control above.
  - Each run was taken at a head whose files it covers are byte-identical at `582982e`, apart from three test files and `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs`. Those were re-run at `582982e`: 12 files, 538 passed.
- **Narrowed consumer sweep:** the 53 test files outside the moved packages that name a moved tag (`app-shell`, `components`, `cli`, `sdui-parser`, `plugin-detail`, `plugin-calendar`, `plugin-map`, `plugin-gantt`), plus `element-data-source-objectname-waiver-11117` (it reads `data-source.md`) and `markdown-test-inputs`: 55 files, 882 passed. Selected by tag literal and by source-text read of a changed file. A consumer that renders a moved block without naming its tag is outside this selection, and CI covers it.
- **Gates at this head, each exit 0:**
  - `changeset:check`, `check-changeset-presence` (8 changesets over 9 released packages), `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`;
  - `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (`0 new citation(s)`);
  - `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` (1 key added, 0 en values changed), `check:i18n-dead-keys` (`view.noObject` not listed);

  - Earlier on the branch, also each exit 0: `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:component-surface-parity`, `check:registry-bare-names`, `check:prompt-keys`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:side-effects-array`.
- `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the 40 paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- **eslint** (`--no-inline-config --format json`) over the 30 touched ts/tsx/mjs files: 0 errors. For each modified file, the warning count and the multiset of rule ids are equal at base (fed by `--stdin --stdin-filename`) and at head. The three new test files carry 0 warnings. The config has no type-aware linting (no `project` / `projectService`), so this diff cannot move the verdict on an untouched file.
- **NOT MEASURED, left to CI:**
  - `check:eager-closure`, `check:eager-locale-catalogues` and `check:sdui-registration-pins` need a built console (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`). This diff adds one short string to each eager pack and a small component to the gate.
  - `check:doc-snippets` and `check:doc-examples` need built packages (exit 2). Neither docs edit adds a code fence.
  - `check:readme-exports` is judged on built type entries and could not judge any README here. The README edit adds no fence.

## Acceptance notes

- **`record:related_list.columns` is ledgered, not moved.** The registration requires `columns`, but the spec row leaves it optional, and the gate maps a named view's field list onto it (`columns: true`). So a node bound to a view with its own `columns` is refused. Measured at this head: `record:related_list` with `objectName`, `relationshipField` and `dataSource={{ object: "task", view: "open_tasks" }}` gets `ok: false`, `missing-required-prop` naming `columns`. It is outside this card's `objectName` scope, and a node bound by `object` alone still needs columns. The dev report carried it to the seat, which filed it as objectui#11613.
- **`object-grid` is not opted into the hint.** Its own error already answers the neither node.
- **A metric's `fallbackValue` opts out of the hint**, because the author chose a static tile. With an adapter in context the tile still shows its dash rather than that value, as before this change. Recorded only.
- **The two faces differ on the neither node, as the ruling expects.** The page compile accepts it, and the zod record-source rule still refuses it on `list-view`, `object-grid`, `object-kanban`, `embeddable-form` and `object-pivot`.
- **A `simple` (or unset) `formType` whose sections are fully inline also opts out of the hint now**, because `hasInlineFieldSource` answers for every variant. `ObjectForm`'s simple path does not read inline sections, so with no object that node still draws an empty form, as it did before this PR. It is a missed hint, not a regression.
- **A designer preview of a placed block** with no object yet now shows the hint rather than an empty shell. The `app-shell` tests that name these tags are green.
